scope: Every component selected by the frozen new-material trigger policy; no per-case model selection.

requirements: Both proposal-aware and names-only checks are observed or partial.
Both checks have medium or high confidence and severity at least 2.
The checks share at least one issue code.
confirmed_consensus.component: Use minimum severity and confidence, partial visibility if either check is partial, shared issue codes only, and application-derived evidence quoting both checks.

requirements: Either check is confidently clear or minor (observed/partial, medium/high confidence, severity 0 or 1); or
Both checks are confidently material but have disjoint issue codes.
rejected_addition.final_decision: Do not auto-fail; record disagreement and cap high reported confidence to medium.

requirements: A check is unobservable or reports low-confidence material and there is no confidently clear counter-assessment; or
The pair does not satisfy another resolution rule.
unconfirmed_addition.final_decision: If baseline and merged verdicts are pass, defer to review with explicit uncertainty; preserve an existing fail.

nontrigger_components: Use the existing deterministic two-pass policy unchanged.
disclosure: The policy was selected after root inspection of the four NEW160 trigger cases. NEW160 consensus output is a posthoc development probe, not held-out validation.
